verdict.rationale: Raygun documents real-time deployment tracking to spot new errors or regressions per release (raygun-docs-31). It also offers a Deployments API (raygun-docs-8) and error segmentation by version (raygun-docs-3), which give a thin, error-centric view of per-release health. Missing for 10: crash-free session and crash-free user metrics, adoption-per-release tracking, an explicit canary-vs-last-stable comparison view, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
